### Safe Vector Field Following on Quadrotors

Embedding safe low-dimensional vector fields into complex dynamics using geometric control methods. [Read the paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.06629).

### Learning for Layered Safety-Critical Control

Learning to safely control a 3D hopping robot using predictive forward simulation and control barrier functions. [Read the paper](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v283/compton25a.html)
:::
